text:
- [LADP.1.3] **Adapter.** Integrator code that bridges an external
  system's data model into DS's fact model **or** provides a
  compute/service role DS calls into. Adapters ship a `.ds`
  library file declaring their services and related schemas
  (consumed by the compiler per [LIMP]), and a
  binary that registers per-service callbacks against libds's C
  API at engine init ([LADP.8.1]). What is external is the
  system being bridged, not the adapter: there is no wire
  between an adapter and the engine. Typical adapters: Home
  Assistant bridge, MQTT bridge, weather-provider bridge, notify
  service, ML worker, tool server, another DS tier via
  cross-tier fact flow. DS runs properly with zero adapters —
  they are how rules touch the world, not how the engine itself
  stays up.
